class.name: SteamResult
class.brief_description: Terminal status shared by Steam client actions.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Returns the terminal Godot error. [constant OK] means the action succeeded under its documented completion contract.

method.name: get_message
method.description: Returns the action's diagnostic. A failed action that supplies no specific detail returns the Godot error description. A successful action can leave this empty.

members.member: True if the action succeeded under its documented completion contract.
Godot error for the terminal outcome. Zero indicates success.
Diagnostic for the outcome. A failed action can fall back to its Godot error description.
